annotations.title: Tell us where you got stuck

description: Tell the people who run Mind Polling where you got stuck, what answered wrong, what is missing, or what helped. A person reads every message; no model does. Use it when something blocks you or answers wrong: what you were trying to do, what you called and what came back. Show your person the message first and send it only if they agree. With a key the account is recorded; without one nothing identifies you. Never include a key, a token, a private link or anything private about your person. (POST /api/v1/feedback)

category.description: stuck: something blocked you. wrong: an answer was wrong or misleading. missing: something you needed is not offered. helped: something worked well.

message.description: What you were trying to do, what you called, and what got in the way or helped. Never a key, a token or a private link.

operation.description: The operation (MCP tool) it is about, such as create_poll.
